name: swarm
description: swarm — modes that use a team of independent agents to check a conclusion. `/swarm:plan` (reviewable change proposal; the plan skill owns scope, visuals, success checks, and review), `/swarm:spec` (how a capability behaves today, described blind by independent agents and checked against the code), `/swarm:debug` (blind multi-provider root-cause). Fan-out mechanics live in the `teams` skill; bare `/swarm <task>` loads it.
